findings.text: Open-beat scribble loop (drawn 3.13 s, held to 7.3 s) still dips under the engine caption card: its lower right arc is clipped at y about 1180, ten pixels past the 1170 key band, and from 6.9 s it rings TURKMENISTAN alone with empty ink inside the loop. Shrink or lift the loop so it closes above y 1170.

The cream SCREEN RECORDING sticker is now a clean rounded rectangle with the text inside it, but its lower-left corner overlaps the top-right corner of the coral XINJIANG swipe (about 15 px, 13.5 to 18.0 s). Nudge the sticker 20 px right or up.

Thread end-ring is tangent to the top edge of the KRISH'S TEST sticker (zoomed crop at 19.0 s, still true at 20.5 s): the ring touches the sticker outline rather than clearing it. Move the sticker 20 px down or shorten the end thread.

Stamp slap overshoot: at 12.0 s the Turkmenistan flag is oversized and hides the label down to 'nistan' for about one frame (clear by 12.1 s). Similarly at 9.8 s the ChatGPT 2/2 numeral overshoots its card and meets the scribble loop for a few frames. Transient and reads as a slap, but a visible collision on a paused frame.

Deletion is in sync (text present at 16.6 s, gone at 16.7 s, 'deletes' swipe lands 16.7 s). The mint underline stays at full strength over blank white at 16.7 s and fades by about 17.0 s, so it floats on empty space for roughly 0.3 s. It reads as a strike-out ghost; shorten the fade if you want it clean.

Approved-design concern: from about 7.7 to 9.3 s the glass shows one small Claude card in the top third of the phone with the rest of the screen empty ink, which is longer than a brief empty body. ChatGPT only arrives at about 9.3 s while the headline and dek already say two for two.

Real refusal text ('Sorry, that's beyond my current scope') is about 20 px in the recording from 16.7 s while the 44 px pull-quote card still quotes the deleted answer; the refusal only gets its own 44 px bubble from 18.07 s. Approved retyped-bubble design, so a note only.

ILLUSTRATION tag stays on screen across the real DeepSeek recording beat. It is spec-correct (a generated plate is behind it) and the cream SCREEN RECORDING sticker labels the real footage, but the two labels sit close together. Evidence is not redrawn: the recording, cursor, streamed answer and deletion are the real capture.

DeepSeek cards show bare 0 and 1 under the flags with no denominator or unit; the 2/2, ? OUT OF 2 and 3/3 numbers all carry a denominator and the KRISH'S TEST 23 OCT producer sticker. Minor Critic Q4 gap.

Verdict scribble is mint on a dark phone screen; the template says cream on dark and mint on light. Mint on ink is brand-legal (13.4:1) but the open, result and evidence scribbles use cream or mint-on-white, so this one is a slight inconsistency.

Approved-design concern: the thread chart's cream hairlines and the TURKMENISTAN header (cap height 21 px, about 30 px type) sit over a bright cotton boll, so contrast is lower on the right half of the chart. It is also structurally close to a table (ruled header, two rule columns, three rows), though flags, wobble and the parted DeepSeek thread keep it from reading as a spreadsheet.
First 0.3 s is an empty ink frame with only the header and a 'Now,' caption; the phone enters at frame 9. A poster or autoplay first frame has no focal object.
